editorial.blurb: Taste of Kalavara delivers authentic Kerala cuisine and beyond in a clean, welcoming space with attentive service and reasonable prices.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the vada with mutton curry—an unexpected pairing that works beautifully—and don't skip the masala dosa, which nails the texture balance of soft and crunchy.
